about: Rash guard tiles (Swimming, Fight Wear): Tripo model rashguard-parts.glb (cards 55098 / 54953, long-sleeve compression top), HOODIE/MODELQ6 2026-11-20: the PARTS file is the model (the user: rashguard-textured.glb came out twice with no collar band, no cuff roll and no proper sleeve ends; the parts file has them), coloured from its own parts by viewer/tripo-hoodie.mjs (viewer/parts/rashguard.json). Replaces the old rashguard.glb. Tile look: the existing 'blades' look + the model flag; `look` is only the check design.
